Automated behaviors ("from now on when X", "each time X", "whenever X", "before/after X") require hooks configured in settings.json - the harness executes these, not Claude, so memory/preferences cannot fulfill them. Also use for: permissions ("allow X", "add permission", "move permission to"), env vars ("set X=Y"), hook troubleshooting, or any changes to settings.json/settings.local.json files. Examples: "allow npm commands", "add bq permission to global settings", "move permission to user settings", "set DEBUG=true", "when claude stops show X". 7	Custom PHP 7.4 MVC + Three.js + Theatre.js web agency site renewal project.
8	
9	**Key architecture decisions:**
10	- Routing: closure-based (`routes/web.php` + `render()`) — NOT controller-class MVC
11	- Three.js scenes: `resource/ts/pages/<page>/scene/`
12	- Theatre.js bindings: `resource/ts/pages/<page>/theatre/`
13	- Shared code: outside page folders (`resource/ts/runtime/`, `resource/ts/manager/`, etc.)
14	- TypeScript types: dedicated `resource/ts/types/*.types.ts` files — no inline types, no `any`
15	- Build: Vite (bundle) + sass CLI (CSS) — never run `npm run build` (dev server auto-rebuilds on save)
16	- DB tables: `nb_` prefix (e.g. `nb_siteinfo`, `nb_admin`)
17	
18	**Notable shared utilities (resource/ts/):**
19	
20	| 파일 | 역할 |
21	|---|---|
22	| `app/ResizeSetup.ts` | resize debounce + visualViewport 동기화 |
23	| `runtime/SubpageStarfieldRuntime.ts` | contact/careers/inside 공통 3D 별빛 parallax |
24	| `ui/WorkCard.ts` | canvas 기반 WorkCard 텍스처 렌더링 유틸 |
25	| `utils/Device.ts` | iOS visualViewport 포함 기기/뷰포트 감지 |
26	| `utils/PerformanceProfile.ts` | 성능 티어 자동 선택 (low/mid/high) |
27	
28	**bfcache 지원 패턴 (2026-04-24 정착):**
29	- `pageshow` + `pagehide` 이벤트로 RAF 체인 재시작/종료
30	- `app.ts`, `AnimationLoop.ts`, `LenisRuntime.ts`, `SubpageStarfieldRuntime.ts` 모두 적용
31	- `beforeunload` 사용 금지 (bfcache 진입 차단)
32	
33	**Author/editor 모드 패턴:**
34	- `data-*-mode="author"` attr → `_utils.scss` 셀렉터로 UI 격리
35	- Theatre.js Studio 편집 중 header, panel, intro 요소를 pointer-events:none + 투명 처리
36	
37	**SEO 인프라:**
38	- `robots.txt`: admin/api 경로 차단, sitemap 참조 포함
39	- `views/pages/sitemap.php`: works/news/insight/award 동적 XML 사이트맵

41	**Why:** Designed to eliminate Barba.js/SPA contracts and enforce clear ownership separation between AppManager, PageRuntime, and PageTheatreBinder.

# `resource/ts/` Structure Map

## 1. Top-level directories (책임 한 줄)

| Dir | Responsibility |
|---|---|
| `app.ts` | 단일 진입점. `AppManager.init()` 호출 + bfcache `pageshow`/`pagehide` 라이프사이클 등록 |
| `app/` | 부트 직전 환경/객체 셋업 헬퍼 (`EnvSetup`, `ObjectSetup`) |
| `manager/` | 전역 싱글턴 매니저 (앱·인트로·옵저버·셰이더·QA·배경) |
| `runtime/` | 재사용 가능한 라이프사이클 단위. init/dispose 보유, 페이지에 의존하지 않음 |
| `core/` | Three.js 엔진·씬·로더 등 저수준 (Engine, Scene, AnimationLoop, ModelLoader, PostProcessor, AppBootstrap, PageTheatreBinder, ObjectFactoryRegistry, setup) |
| `controller/` | Page/Background/Shader/Timeline 컨트롤러 — 1프레임 동기화 책임 |
| `pages/<page>/scene/` | 페이지별 Three.js 씬 정의 |
| `pages/<page>/theatre/` | 페이지별 Theatre.js 시트·브리지·런타임 |
| `pages/<page>/runtime|render/` | 페이지 전용 런타임/렌더 매니저 (works만 보유) |
| `objects/{env,main,shared,sub,rocket}/` | 재사용 Three.js Object3D 클래스 (Earth, Planet, Background, CloudPlane, Rocket, Astronaut 등) |
| `lib/theatre/` | Theatre.js 래퍼 서비스 (Studio, Project, Sheet, Sequence, Playback, StateStorage) |
| `lib/lenis/` | LenisRuntime — 전역 스무스 스크롤 |
| `ui/` | DOM UI 위젯 (Header, Drawer, Dropdown, Panel, IntroOverlay, IntroCanvas, GaugeCanvas, HudPanel, BlockOverlay, NormalOverlay, ContactWizard, WorkModal, WorkCard, UI) |
| `components/` | 재사용 동작/효과 (Button, Marquee, CharBtn, CustomCursor, ImagePreview, WhySkillPreview, Suspense, Toast, Category, Component) |
| `animation/` | Animation, SceneShake, TextReveal, BlockReveal |
| `builder/` | TimelineBuilder |
| `config/` | 정적 상수 (object, base, env, ground, scene-light, timeline, transition, intro, dom, component, background) |
| `utils/` | Helpers, Logger, Debounce, Guards, Aria, FrameScheduler, Device, PerformanceProfile, ResponsiveValue, ScrollLock, CloseAllExpanded, disposeObject3D, Debug, LinearSpline, Physic, domUtil |
| `validation/` | ContactFormValidation |
| `api/` | getWork — 백엔드 fetch |
| `types/*.types.ts` | 모든 공유 타입 (app, about, contact, main, work, runtime, engine, core, dom, theatre, intro, gsap, shader, object*, component) |

## 2. AppManager / PageRuntime / PageTheatreBinder 경계

- **`manager/AppManager.ts`** (싱글턴, 정적 `init`/`disposeBootstrap`): 앱 전체 부트스트랩의 오너. Engine 생성, EnvSetup, AppBootstrap, IntroController/IntroManager, IntroOverlay, ScrollSceneRuntime/SceneSheetEffectRuntime/ScenePolicyRuntime/IntroFlowRuntime/IntroHandoffRuntime/AppEngineRuntime/AppStartupRuntime/AppOrbitRuntime를 조립. Hero·About/Main showcase·Contact form 같은 **DOM ↔ scene 동기화**를 내부 `AppManagerDomRuntime`로 처리. Theatre 어댑터는 `PageTheatreBinder`로 위임.
- **`runtime/PageRuntime.ts`**: **페이지 단위 DOM/UI 라이프사이클**. `runPage(root)` → `_globalUiRuntime`(Header/Drawer/Dropdown/WorkModal/CustomCursor/MagneticCorner/TextReveal/BlockReveal/ContactWizard/Suspense/Marquee/CharBtn/ImagePreview/WhySkillPreview/PinnedReveal/QaManager) + `_featureCardCanvasRuntime` + `_subpageStarfieldRuntime` 초기화 후 `PageController` 부착. 3D 엔진은 다루지 않음.
- **`core/PageTheatreBinder.ts`**: 페이지 ID(`pageMain|pageAbout|pageContact`)에 맞는 Theatre 어댑터 팩토리를 동적 import → `applyBootStateIfNeeded / startPreviewIfNeeded / startIntroIfNeeded / startAfterIntroIfNeeded / startIntroActionPhase{One,Two}IfNeeded / stopPreview / getSceneSyncPort` 메서드로 통일. 페이지별 Theatre 호출은 모두 여기로 모임.

규칙: **3D/Theatre 흐름 = AppManager + PageTheatreBinder**, **DOM/UI 흐름 = PageRuntime**. 페이지 폴더는 자기 페이지에만 쓰이는 코드만, 공통 흐름은 `runtime/`에 둘 것.

## 3. 페이지 초기화 흐름

`app.ts:43 deferStart()` → `AppManager.init()` (`AppManager.ts:1035`) → `AppManagerDomRuntime` 준비 → `Engine`(`core/Engine.ts`) + `EnvSetup` + `AppBootstrap` 생성 → `pageMain|pageAbout|pageContact` 식별 → `PageTheatreBinder` 어댑터 로드 → `AppStartupRuntime.run()` (인트로/부트 상태) → `IntroFlowRuntime`/`IntroHandoffRuntime` → `ScrollSceneRuntime` 마운트 → 본 씬 `AppOrbitRuntime` 루프 진입. DOM 라이프사이클은 별도로 `PageRuntime.runPage(root)`가 같은 시점에 실행되어 `PageController`를 띄움.

## 4. `manager/`

| 파일 | 책임 |
|---|---|
| `AppManager.ts` | 앱 전체 부트/디스포즈 오너. 페이지 흐름 분기 진입점 |
| `BackgroundManager.ts` | 메인 배경(Background object) 생성·전환·디스포즈 |
| `IntroManager.ts` | 인트로 시퀀스 상태/단계 머신, IntroController 협력 |
| `ObserveManager.ts` | IntersectionObserver 풀 — DOM 가시성 트래킹 |
| `QaManager.ts` | QA(접힘/펼침 등) 인터랙션. PageRuntime이 init |
| `ShaderManager.ts` | 셰이더 핸들/유니폼 일괄 관리 |

`ResponsiveRuntime`은 `runtime/`에 있음(매니저 아님).

## 5. `runtime/`

페이지 비종속, init/dispose 가진 횡단 모듈.

| 파일 | 역할 |
|---|---|
| `PageRuntime.ts` | DOM/UI 페이지 라이프사이클(위 참조) |
| `PageBootRuntime.ts` | 페이지별 부트 시퀀스 헬퍼 |
| `AppEngineRuntime.ts` | Engine 라이프사이클 래퍼 |
| `AppStartupRuntime.ts` | 시작 시 한 번 실행되는 부트 액션 |
| `AppOrbitRuntime.ts` | 메인 렌더 루프 (orbit/raf) |
| `IntroFlowRuntime.ts` / `IntroHandoffRuntime.ts` / `IntroLoadingRuntime.ts` | 인트로 단계·핸드오프·로딩 |
| `ScenePolicyRuntime.ts` | 씬 활성화/페이즈 정책 결정 |
| `SceneTransitionRuntime.ts` | 씬 전환 (TransitionVeil 협력) |
| `SceneSheetEffectRuntime.ts` | Theatre Sheet 기반 후처리 효과 |
| `ScrollSceneRuntime.ts` | 스크롤 ↔ 씬 진행도 매핑 |
| `ScrollSceneRuntime.ts`/`ScrollSceneRuntime` 등 | 페이지 스크롤 ↔ Theatre sequence |

| `manager/` | 전역 싱글턴 매니저 (앱·인트로·옵저버·셰이더·QA·배경) |

| `pages/<page>/theatre/` | 페이지별 Theatre.js 시트·브리지·런타임 |

## 2. AppManager / PageRuntime / PageTheatreBinder 경계

- **`manager/AppManager.ts`** (싱글턴, 정적 `init`/`disposeBootstrap`): 앱 전체 부트스트랩의 오너. Engine 생성, EnvSetup, AppBootstrap, IntroController/IntroManager, IntroOverlay, ScrollSceneRuntime/SceneSheetEffectRuntime/ScenePolicyRuntime/IntroFlowRuntime/IntroHandoffRuntime/AppEngineRuntime/AppStartupRuntime/AppOrbitRuntime를 조립. Hero·About/Main showcase·Contact form 같은 **DOM ↔ scene 동기화**를 내부 `AppManagerDomRuntime`로 처리. Theatre 어댑터는 `PageTheatreBinder`로 위임.
- **`runtime/PageRuntime.ts`**: **페이지 단위 DOM/UI 라이프사이클**. `runPage(root)` → `_globalUiRuntime`(Header/Drawer/Dropdown/WorkModal/CustomCursor/MagneticCorner/TextReveal/BlockReveal/ContactWizard/Suspense/Marquee/CharBtn/ImagePreview/WhySkillPreview/PinnedReveal/QaManager) + `_featureCardCanvasRuntime` + `_subpageStarfieldRuntime` 초기화 후 `PageController` 부착. 3D 엔진은 다루지 않음.
- **`core/PageTheatreBinder.ts`**: 페이지 ID(`pageMain|pageAbout|pageContact`)에 맞는 Theatre 어댑터 팩토리를 동적 import → `applyBootStateIfNeeded / startPreviewIfNeeded / startIntroIfNeeded / startAfterIntroIfNeeded / startIntroActionPhase{One,Two}IfNeeded / stopPreview / getSceneSyncPort` 메서드로 통일. 페이지별 Theatre 호출은 모두 여기로 모임.

규칙: **3D/Theatre 흐름 = AppManager + PageTheatreBinder**, **DOM/UI 흐름 = PageRuntime**. 페이지 폴더는 자기 페이지에만 쓰이는 코드만, 공통 흐름은 `runtime/`에 둘 것.

## 3. 페이지 초기화 흐름

`app.ts:43 deferStart()` → `AppManager.init()` (`AppManager.ts:1035`) → `AppManagerDomRuntime` 준비 → `Engine`(`core/Engine.ts`) + `EnvSetup` + `AppBootstrap` 생성 → `pageMain|pageAbout|pageContact` 식별 → `PageTheatreBinder` 어댑터 로드 → `AppStartupRuntime.run()` (인트로/부트 상태) → `IntroFlowRuntime`/`IntroHandoffRuntime` → `ScrollSceneRuntime` 마운트 → 본 씬 `AppOrbitRuntime` 루프 진입. DOM 라이프사이클은 별도로 `PageRuntime.runPage(root)`가 같은 시점에 실행되어 `PageController`를 띄움.

## NINEONELABS SCSS 아키텍처 맵

### 1. 디렉토리 구조 및 역할

| 디렉토리 | 파일 | 역할 |
|---------|------|------|
| **abstract/** | `index.scss`, `_variables.scss`, `_colors.scss`, `_functions.scss`, `_mixins.scss`, `_headings.scss` | 헬퍼 함수, 믹스인, 색상 맵, 타이포그래피 맵 재사용 |
| **base/** | `index.scss`, `_fonts.scss`, `_init.scss`, `_reset.scss`, `_root.scss`, `_utils.scss` | 글로벌 CSS 리셋, :root 토큰(--*), author 모드 셀렉터 |
| **components/** | `.scss` 23개 + hud/ 서브폴더 | 버튼, 폼, 모달, 패널, 로딩 등 UI 컴포넌트별 스타일 |
| **layouts/** | `_header.scss`, `_drawer.scss`, `_footer.scss` | 전역 레이아웃 구조 |
| **pages/** | `_main.scss`, `_sub.scss`, `_works-canvas.scss` | 페이지별 고유 스타일 |
| **state/** | `_reveal-state.scss` | TS 드리븐 `[data-mask]`, `[data-reveal]`, `is-*` 상태 스타일 |

**Entry Point**: `/resource/scss/style.scss` — `@layer` 선언과 `meta.load-css()` 사용. 로드 순서는 reset → base → layout → components → pages → utilities → state

---

### 2. Abstract 내 핵심 헬퍼

**_functions.scss:**
- `fluid($y1, $y2, $x1: 375, $x2: 1920)` → `clamp(min, vw + base, max)` 반환
- `minus-fluid(...)` → 음수 버전
- `pxToRem($px)` → `$px * 0.1rem` (35px → 3.5rem)

**_mixins.scss:**
- `mq($key-or-size, $direction: "max")` → `@media (max-width|min-width: ...px)`
- `mq-min()`, `mq-max()` → 방향 래퍼
- `@mixin font($name)` → `@include font("ds-heading-1")` → heading 맵에서 `fs-fluid-by-map()` 자동 로드
- `set-fluid($map)` → 맵 기반 fluid 속성 생성
- `section-fluid-by-map($map)` → padding-top/bottom 일괄 설정
- `fs-fluid-by-map($map)`, `fs-static-by-map($map)` → 타이포그래피 적용
- `flex-center()`, `pos-full()`, `pos-center()`, `img-cover()`, `line-clamp()`, `blind()` 등 자주 쓰는 패턴

**_variables.scss:**
- `$font-familys` — "Pretendard", "ClashDisplay-Variable", "Orbitron", "Geist Mono" 매핑
- `$containers` — xs(375), sm(544), md(768), lg(1024), xl(1440), 2xl(1640), 3xl(1920)
- `$gutters` — 3xs~4xl 간격. `var(--gutter-md)` 등으로 사용
- `$sections` — padding 양쪽 용 fluid 맵 (xl, lg, md, sm, footer)
- `$fluid-customs` — 커스텀 fluid 맵 (콘텐츠 모듈 높이 등)

**_headings.scss:**
- `$fluid-displays` (x, 0, 1_5, 1, 2) — min 42~48, max 80~136
- `$fluid-headings` (1~5) — min 16~24, max 24~48
- `$fluid-bodys` (1~5) — min 10~15, max 12~20
- `$fluid-typography` — 위 셋을 통합 맵. `@include font("ds-heading-1")` 호출 시 이 맵 참조

**_colors.scss:**
- `$theme-colors-light` 및 `$theme-colors-dark` — primitives (primary, gray, ui) + tokens (text, border, background 등)
- `theme-colors-flat()` 함수로 평탄화

---

### 3. Base 내 글로벌 토큰 (:root)

**_root.scss — 약 200개의 --* CSS 변수:**
- **Typography**: `--base-font-size`, `--base-line-height`, `--base-letter-spacing` (fluid)
- **Layout**: `--header-height`, `--hud-unit`, `--gutter-*` (3xs~4xl), `--gutter-container` (fluid)
- **Z-index**: `--z-index-bg` (-1) ~ `--z-index-custom-cursor` (2147483647)
- **Form**: `--input-height`, `--form-file-action-size`, `--form-control-transition`, `--form-choice-*` (color-mix 활용)
- **Duration**: `--duration-instant` (0.1s) ~ `--duration-slower` (1s), `--duration-stagger` (0.08s)
- **Easing**: `--ease-default`, `--ease-spring`, `--ease-bounce` 등 cubic-bezier
- **Motion**: `--block-reveal-offset-y: 18px`, `--text-reveal-offset-y: 4px` 등
- **Shadow/Scrollbar**: `--shadow-floating-card`, `--scrollbar-width` (fluid)
- **Shiny CTA**: `--shiny-cta-bg`, `--shiny-cta-fg`, `--shiny-cta-highlight`
- **색상**: `--clr-text-*`, `--clr-border-*`, `--clr-background-*` 등 (color 맵에서 flat)

**_reset.scss:**
- `*` → `margin: 0; padding: 0; box-sizing: border-box;`
- html → font-size: 62.5%; text-rendering 최적화
- body → 기본 폰트, 색상, word-break: keep-all

**_utils.scss:**
- author 모드: `html[data-*-mode="author"]` 선택자 → 캔버스만 표시, UI 숨김

**_fonts.scss:**

| `@include font("...")` | 타이포그래피 적용 시 |

| **pages/** | `_main.scss`, `_sub.scss`, `_works-canvas.scss` | 페이지별 고유 스타일 |
| **state/** | `_reveal-state.scss` | TS 드리븐 `[data-mask]`, `[data-reveal]`, `is-*` 상태 스타일 |

**Entry Point**: `/resource/scss/style.scss` — `@layer` 선언과 `meta.load-css()` 사용. 로드 순서는 reset → base → layout → components → pages → utilities → state

- `minus-fluid(...)` → 음수 버전
- `pxToRem($px)` → `$px * 0.1rem` (35px → 3.5rem)

**_mixins.scss:**
- `mq($key-or-size, $direction: "max")` → `@media (max-width|min-width: ...px)`
- `mq-min()`, `mq-max()` → 방향 래퍼
- `@mixin font($name)` → `@include font("ds-heading-1")` → heading 맵에서 `fs-fluid-by-map()` 자동 로드
- `set-fluid($map)` → 맵 기반 fluid 속성 생성
- `section-fluid-by-map($map)` → padding-top/bottom 일괄 설정
- `fs-fluid-by-map($map)`, `fs-static-by-map($map)` → 타이포그래피 적용
- `flex-center()`, `pos-full()`, `pos-center()`, `img-cover()`, `line-clamp()`, `blind()` 등 자주 쓰는 패턴

**_variables.scss:**
- `$font-familys` — "Pretendard", "ClashDisplay-Variable", "Orbitron", "Geist Mono" 매핑
- `$containers` — xs(375), sm(544), md(768), lg(1024), xl(1440), 2xl(1640), 3xl(1920)
- `$gutters` — 3xs~4xl 간격. `var(--gutter-md)` 등으로 사용
- `$sections` — padding 양쪽 용 fluid 맵 (xl, lg, md, sm, footer)
- `$fluid-customs` — 커스텀 fluid 맵 (콘텐츠 모듈 높이 등)

**_headings.scss:**
- `$fluid-displays` (x, 0, 1_5, 1, 2) — min 42~48, max 80~136
- `$fluid-headings` (1~5) — min 16~24, max 24~48
- `$fluid-bodys` (1~5) — min 10~15, max 12~20
- `$fluid-typography` — 위 셋을 통합 맵. `@include font("ds-heading-1")` 호출 시 이 맵 참조

**_colors.scss:**
- `$theme-colors-light` 및 `$theme-colors-dark` — primitives (primary, gray, ui) + tokens (text, border, background 등)
- `theme-colors-flat()` 함수로 평탄화

- **Layout**: `--header-height`, `--hud-unit`, `--gutter-*` (3xs~4xl), `--gutter-container` (fluid)
- **Z-index**: `--z-index-bg` (-1) ~ `--z-index-custom-cursor` (2147483647)
- **Form**: `--input-height`, `--form-file-action-size`, `--form-control-transition`, `--form-choice-*` (color-mix 활용)
- **Duration**: `--duration-instant` (0.1s) ~ `--duration-slower` (1s), `--duration-stagger` (0.08s)
- **Easing**: `--ease-default`, `--ease-spring`, `--ease-bounce` 등 cubic-bezier
- **Motion**: `--block-reveal-offset-y: 18px`, `--text-reveal-offset-y: 4px` 등
- **Shadow/Scrollbar**: `--shadow-floating-card`, `--scrollbar-width` (fluid)
- **Shiny CTA**: `--shiny-cta-bg`, `--shiny-cta-fg`, `--shiny-cta-highlight`
- **색상**: `--clr-text-*`, `--clr-border-*`, `--clr-background-*` 등 (color 맵에서 flat)

**_reset.scss:**
- `*` → `margin: 0; padding: 0; box-sizing: border-box;`
- html → font-size: 62.5%; text-rendering 최적화
- body → 기본 폰트, 색상, word-break: keep-all

- author 모드: `html[data-*-mode="author"]` 선택자 → 캔버스만 표시, UI 숨김

# NINEONELABS PHP 사이드 구조 매핑 (메모리용)

## 1. 최상위 디렉토리

| 폴더 | 역할 |
|------|------|
| `index.php` | 진입점 — `inc/lib/base.class.php` 부트스트랩 후 `$app->handleRequest()` 실행 |
| `.htaccess` | Apache rewrite — 실제 파일/디렉토리 외 모든 요청을 `index.php`로 |
| `routes/web.php` | 모든 공개 라우트 (closure 기반, `$router->get/post(...)->name(...)`) |
| `views/` | `layouts/`, `pages/`, `components/`, `errors/` |
| `api/` | 단일 파일 `works.php` (REST 엔드포인트 모두 포함) |
| `src/` | PSR-4 (`Core, Database, Http, Routing, View, Menu, Mail` + non-PSR4 `Admin\`, `Bootstrap\`) |
| `inc/` | 레거시 부트스트랩/라이브러리 (`core/`, `lib/`) |
| `config/` | 함수형 헬퍼 (`helpers.php`, `functions.php`, `setup.php`, `inside_board.php`, `hreflang.php`, `project.php`, `utils.php`, `configuration.php`) |
| `admin/` | 자체 진입점 + Controller/Model/lib/pages 구조 (closure MVC와 별개) |
| `database/` | SQL 덤프 + `database/migrations/*.sql` (PHP 미사용 SQL 마이그레이션) |
| `src/Database/migrations/` | 실제 마이그레이터가 실행하는 PHP 마이그레이션 |
| `scripts/` | `backfill-webp.php` (1회성 배치) |

## 2. `render()` 함수

- 정의: `c:\Users\edn_y\renew_nineonelabs\config\helpers.php:30`
- 시그니처: `render(string $template, array $data = [], ?string $viewsPath = null): string`
- 동작: `view()`로 `ViewEngine` 생성 후 `->render()`. `'pages.works.view'` → `views/pages/works/view.php`
- 추가 헬퍼: `view()`, `extend()`, `section()`, `end_section()`, `yield_section()`, `include_view()`
- 엔진 본체: `src/View/ViewEngine.php`, 파사드: `src/View/View.php`

## 3. `inc/lib/` 책임

| 파일 | 역할 |
|------|------|
| `base.class.php` | **메인 부트스트랩** — autoload, ENV, 세션, 어드민 디렉토리/경로/업로드 경로/세션 컨텍스트, 라이선스 검증, 메뉴 init |
| `db.php` | 레거시 DB 연결/헬퍼 |
| `func.php` | 공용 함수 (`imageUpload()`, `imageDelete()` 등) |
| `var.php` | 전역 변수 정의 |
| `site.info.php` | `nb_siteinfo` 로드 |
| `license.php` | 라이선스 검증 로직 |
| `PasswordHashClass.php` | 비밀번호 해시 |
| `StringHelper.php` | 문자열 유틸 |
| `SummerNote.php` | 에디터 헬퍼 |
| `board.class.php` | 게시판 (admin board 영역에서 사용) |

NINEONELABS의 `resource/ts/` 전체 구조와 핵심 진입점·책임 경계.

## 최상위 디렉토리

| Dir | 책임 |
|---|---|
| `app.ts` | 단일 진입점. `AppManager.init()` + bfcache(`pageshow`/`pagehide`) 라이프사이클 |
| `app/` | 부트 직전 환경/객체 셋업 (`EnvSetup`, `ObjectSetup`, `ResizeSetup`) |
| `manager/` | 전역 싱글턴 매니저 (App/Background/Intro/Observe/Qa/Shader) |
| `runtime/` | 재사용 가능한 init/dispose 단위. 페이지 비종속 |
| `core/` | Three.js 엔진·씬·로더 (Engine, AnimationLoop, ModelLoader, PostProcessor, AppBootstrap, **PageTheatreBinder**, ObjectFactoryRegistry) |
| `controller/` | Page/Background/Shader/Timeline 컨트롤러 — 1프레임 동기화 |
| `pages/<page>/scene/` | 페이지별 Three.js 씬 정의 |
| `pages/<page>/theatre/` | 페이지별 Theatre.js 시트·브리지·런타임 |
| `objects/{env,main,shared,sub,rocket}/` | 재사용 Three.js Object3D 클래스 |
| `lib/theatre/` | Theatre.js 래퍼 (Studio, Project, Sheet, Sequence, Playback, StateStorage) |
| `lib/lenis/` | LenisRuntime — 전역 스무스 스크롤 |
| `ui/` | DOM UI 위젯 (Header, Drawer, Dropdown, Panel, IntroOverlay, IntroCanvas, GaugeCanvas, HudPanel, ContactWizard, WorkModal, WorkCard, UI) |
| `components/` | 재사용 동작/효과 (Button, Marquee, CharBtn, CustomCursor, Suspense, Toast 등) |
| `animation/` | Animation, SceneShake, TextReveal, BlockReveal |
| `builder/` | TimelineBuilder |
| `config/` | 정적 상수 (object, base, env, ground, scene-light, timeline, transition, intro, dom, component, background) |
| `utils/` | Helpers, Logger, Debounce, Guards, Aria, FrameScheduler, Device, PerformanceProfile, ResponsiveValue, ScrollLock, disposeObject3D, LinearSpline, Physic, domUtil |
| `validation/` | ContactFormValidation |
| `api/` | getWork — 백엔드 fetch |
| `types/*.types.ts` | 모든 공유 타입 (페이지·런타임·엔진·도메인·컴포넌트·인트로·gsap·shader 등) |

## 책임 경계 (절대 룰)

- **AppManager** (`manager/AppManager.ts`, 싱글턴 정적 init/disposeBootstrap): 앱 전체 부트스트랩 오너. Engine·EnvSetup·AppBootstrap·IntroController/Manager·IntroOverlay·Scene/Intro/App/Orbit Runtime들을 조립. DOM↔scene 동기화는 내부 `AppManagerDomRuntime`. Theatre는 `PageTheatreBinder`로 위임.
- **PageRuntime** (`runtime/PageRuntime.ts`): **DOM/UI 페이지 라이프사이클만**. `runPage(root)` → globalUiRuntime(Header/Drawer/Dropdown/WorkModal/CustomCursor/MagneticCorner/TextReveal/BlockReveal/ContactWizard/Suspense/Marquee/CharBtn/ImagePreview/PinnedReveal/QaManager) + featureCardCanvasRuntime + subpageStarfieldRuntime → PageController. **3D 엔진 안 다룸.**
- **PageTheatreBinder** (`core/PageTheatreBinder.ts`): 페이지 ID(`pageMain|pageAbout|pageContact`) → Theatre 어댑터 동적 import. 통일 인터페이스: `applyBootStateIfNeeded / startPreviewIfNeeded / startIntroIfNeeded / startAfterIntroIfNeeded / startIntroActionPhase{One,Two}IfNeeded / stopPreview / getSceneSyncPort`.

**룰 요약**: 3D/Theatre = AppManager + PageTheatreBinder, DOM/UI = PageRuntime. 페이지 폴더는 자기 페이지 코드만, 공통 흐름은 `runtime/`.

## 페이지 초기화 흐름

`app.ts deferStart()` → `AppManager.init()` → AppManagerDomRuntime → Engine + EnvSetup + AppBootstrap → 페이지 ID 식별 → PageTheatreBinder 어댑터 로드 → AppStartupRuntime.run() → IntroFlowRuntime/IntroHandoffRuntime → ScrollSceneRuntime 마운트 → AppOrbitRuntime 루프. NINEONELABS의 PHP 사이드 (커스텀 MVC, PHP 7.4) 전체 구조.

## 최상위

| 폴더/파일 | 역할 |
|---|---|
| `index.php` | 진입점 — `inc/lib/base.class.php` 부트 → `$app->handleRequest()` |
| `.htaccess` | 실제 파일/디렉토리 외 모두 `index.php`로 rewrite |
| `routes/web.php` | 모든 공개 라우트 (closure 기반) |
| `views/` | `layouts/`, `pages/`, `components/`, `errors/` |
| `api/` | **단일 파일** `works.php` (모든 REST 엔드포인트 + 헬퍼 한 곳) |
| `src/` | PSR-4 (Core/Database/Http/Routing/View/Menu/Mail) + 수동 require (Admin/Bootstrap) |
| `inc/` | 레거시 부트스트랩/라이브러리 (`core/`, `lib/`) |
| `config/` | 함수형 헬퍼 (helpers, functions, setup, hreflang, project, utils, configuration, inside_board) |
| `admin/` | 자체 진입점 + Controller/Model/lib/pages 구조 (closure MVC와 별개) |
| `database/` | SQL 덤프 + `database/migrations/*.sql` (수동 적용 백업) |
| `src/Database/migrations/` | 실제 마이그레이터가 실행하는 PHP 마이그레이션 |
| `scripts/` | `backfill-webp.php` (1회성 배치) |

## render() 함수

- 정의: `config/helpers.php:30`
- 시그니처: `render(string $template, array $data = [], ?string $viewsPath = null): string`
- 동작: `view()` → `ViewEngine` → `->render()`. `'pages.works.view'` → `views/pages/works/view.php`
- 헬퍼 패밀리: `view()`, `extend()`, `section()`, `end_section()`, `yield_section()`, `include_view()`
- 엔진: `src/View/ViewEngine.php`, 파사드: `src/View/View.php`

## inc/lib/

| 파일 | 역할 |
|---|---|
| `base.class.php` | **메인 부트스트랩** — autoload, ENV, 세션, admin 경로/업로드 경로/세션 컨텍스트, 라이선스, 메뉴 init |
| `db.php` | 레거시 DB 연결/헬퍼 |
| `func.php` | 공용 함수 (`imageUpload()` → makeWebpSibling, `imageDelete()` 등) |
| `var.php` | 전역 변수 |
| `site.info.php` | `nb_siteinfo` 로드 |
| `license.php` | 라이선스 검증 |
| `PasswordHashClass.php` | 비밀번호 해시 |
| `StringHelper.php` | 문자열 유틸 |
| `SummerNote.php` | 에디터 헬퍼 |
| `board.class.php` | 게시판 (admin 영역) |
| `menu/*` | 활성 메뉴 (init/config/function) |

## src/ 네임스페이스

- `Core\` — `Application` (싱글턴, `handleRequest()` 라우팅 디스패치), `Config`, `ImageProcessor` (WEBP, 2560px, q82, GD)
- `Database\` — `DB` (PDO 래퍼), `Migrator`, CLI `migrate.php`, `make-migration.php`, `migrations/*.php`
- `Http\` — `Request`, `Response`
- `Routing\` — `Router` (메서드별 routes, named 맵, group stack), `Route`
- `View\` — `View`, `ViewEngine` (layout/section/include 지원)
- `Menu\` — `Menu`, `MenuItem`
- `Mail\` — `Mailer` (PHPMailer 래퍼)
- `Admin\` (PSR-4 미등록 — 수동 require) — `Auth/` (Authenticator, SessionManager, RoleRegistry, LoginAttemptStore), `Menu\AdminMenuRegistry`
- `Bootstrap\` — `AdminDirectoryResolver`, `ErrorHandler`, `LicenseValidator`, `SessionContext`, `UploadPathRegistry`

## views/ 컨벤션

- `layouts/main.php` (단일 chrome)
- `pages/<area>/<page>.php` — dot 표기 호출 (`pages.works.view`)
- `components/` — 재사용 fragment (`button/`, `hud/` 서브폴더 허용)
- `errors/` — `404.php`, `default.php`
- **`partials/` 없음** — 모두 `components/`로 통일

## Admin 영역

- 진입: `admin/index.php` (로그인 폼) — 부트스트랩 직접 require
- 라우팅: closure 라우터 **사용 안 함**, **물리 경로 PHP 파일 = URL** (`/admin/pages/works/edit.php`)
- 인증 가드: 페이지 상단 `require_once .../admin/lib/auth/admin.check.php` (`AdminSessionManager::requireLoginRedirect()`)
- 구조: `Controller/`, `Model/` (예: `WorkController/Model`), `pages/<area>/{index,new,edit}.php`, `pages/<area>/ajax/*.php`, `lib/` (Validator, AdminListSort, AdminJsonResponse, PageContext, Role, WorksAdminHelpers), `inc/` (head/header/drawer/footer fragment), `config/menu.config.php`
- CSS/JS: `admin/resource/` (공개 SCSS 파이프라인과 분리)

## API

- `api/works.php`만 존재. Works 관련 모든 엔드포인트 + `get_work_detail()` 등 헬퍼를 한 파일에. `routes/web.php`의 `$loadWorksApi` closure가 lazy require.

## 마이그레이션 시스템

**두 트랙 공존:**
1. **PHP 마이그레이터 (메인)**: `src/Database/Migrator.php`, CLI `php src/Database/migrate.php`. 추적 테이블 `nb_migrations`. 파일: `src/Database/migrations/YYYYMMDD_HHMMSS_<name>.php` (각 파일 `up()`/`down()` + `$db->exec(...)`)
2. **SQL 보조**: `database/migrations/*.sql` (수동 적용용 스니펫/백업)

- Makefile 없음 (`.claude/rules/php.md`의 `make m`는 표기일 뿐)
- 실제: `php src/Database/migrate.php` 또는 `/migration` skill
- DB 덤프: `database/<날짜>.sql`

## nb_ 테이블 목록

`init_database_schema.php` + 후속 마이그레이션 기준:
`nb_roles`, `nb_branches`, `nb_admin`, `nb_siteinfo`, `nb_branch_seos`, `nb_popups`, `nb_clients`, `nb_faqs`, `nb_board_manage`, `nb_board`, `nb_board_category`, `nb_board_comment`, `nb_board_lev_manage`, `nb_request`, `nb_site_tags`, `nb_works`, `nb_works_sort_no_undo`, `nb_migrations`, `nb_test`

**드롭됨**: `nb_privacy_policy`, `nb_banners`, `nb_category` (`database/migrations/20260405~06_drop_*.sql`)

## 추가 메모

- 이미지 출력은 반드시 `render_uploaded_image()` (`config/functions.php:160`) 경유. 첫 인자는 raw URL — 이중 escape 주의.
- 라우트 그룹 패턴: `$router->group(['prefix'=>'/works'], fn($r) => ...)`
- `Application::handleRequest()`에 로케일 prefix 감지 로직 존재하나 현재 비활성
- composer PSR-4: Core/Database/Http/Routing/View/Menu/Mail. Admin/Bootstrap는 `inc/lib/base.class.php`에서 수동 require

**Why:** 두 라우팅 트랙 (closure + physical-path admin), 두 마이그레이션 트랙 (PHP + SQL), 두 src 로딩 (PSR-4 + manual)이 공존해서 어디 무엇이 있는지 빠른 참조 필요.
**How to apply:** 새 공개 페이지 = closure routes. 새 admin 페이지 = `admin/pages/<area>/`. 새 API = `api/works.php` 패턴 따라 단일 파일 또는 lazy require closure. DB 변경 = `/migration` skill.

| `api/` | **단일 파일** `works.php` (모든 REST 엔드포인트 + 헬퍼 한 곳) |
| `src/` | PSR-4 (Core/Database/Http/Routing/View/Menu/Mail) + 수동 require (Admin/Bootstrap) |
| `inc/` | 레거시 부트스트랩/라이브러리 (`core/`, `lib/`) |
| `config/` | 함수형 헬퍼 (helpers, functions, setup, hreflang, project, utils, configuration, inside_board) |
| `admin/` | 자체 진입점 + Controller/Model/lib/pages 구조 (closure MVC와 별개) |
| `database/` | SQL 덤프 + `database/migrations/*.sql` (수동 적용 백업) |
| `src/Database/migrations/` | 실제 마이그레이터가 실행하는 PHP 마이그레이션 |
| `scripts/` | `backfill-webp.php` (1회성 배치) |

## render() 함수

- 정의: `config/helpers.php:30`
- 시그니처: `render(string $template, array $data = [], ?string $viewsPath = null): string`
- 동작: `view()` → `ViewEngine` → `->render()`. `'pages.works.view'` → `views/pages/works/view.php`
- 헬퍼 패밀리: `view()`, `extend()`, `section()`, `end_section()`, `yield_section()`, `include_view()`
- 엔진: `src/View/ViewEngine.php`, 파사드: `src/View/View.php`

## inc/lib/

| 파일 | 역할 |
|---|---|
| `base.class.php` | **메인 부트스트랩** — autoload, ENV, 세션, admin 경로/업로드 경로/세션 컨텍스트, 라이선스, 메뉴 init |
| `db.php` | 레거시 DB 연결/헬퍼 |
| `func.php` | 공용 함수 (`imageUpload()` → makeWebpSibling, `imageDelete()` 등) |
| `var.php` | 전역 변수 |
| `site.info.php` | `nb_siteinfo` 로드 |
| `license.php` | 라이선스 검증 |
| `PasswordHashClass.php` | 비밀번호 해시 |
| `StringHelper.php` | 문자열 유틸 |
| `SummerNote.php` | 에디터 헬퍼 |
| `board.class.php` | 게시판 (admin 영역) |
| `menu/*` | 활성 메뉴 (init/config/function) |

## src/ 네임스페이스

- `Core\` — `Application` (싱글턴, `handleRequest()` 라우팅 디스패치), `Config`, `ImageProcessor` (WEBP, 2560px, q82, GD)
- `Database\` — `DB` (PDO 래퍼), `Migrator`, CLI `migrate.php`, `make-migration.php`, `migrations/*.php`
- `Http\` — `Request`, `Response`
- `Routing\` — `Router` (메서드별 routes, named 맵, group stack), `Route`
- `View\` — `View`, `ViewEngine` (layout/section/include 지원)
- `Menu\` — `Menu`, `MenuItem`
- `Mail\` — `Mailer` (PHPMailer 래퍼)
- `Admin\` (PSR-4 미등록 — 수동 require) — `Auth/` (Authenticator, SessionManager, RoleRegistry, LoginAttemptStore), `Menu\AdminMenuRegistry`
- `Bootstrap\` — `AdminDirectoryResolver`, `ErrorHandler`, `LicenseValidator`, `SessionContext`, `UploadPathRegistry`

## views/ 컨벤션

- `layouts/main.php` (단일 chrome)
- `pages/<area>/<page>.php` — dot 표기 호출 (`pages.works.view`)
- `components/` — 재사용 fragment (`button/`, `hud/` 서브폴더 허용)
- `errors/` — `404.php`, `default.php`
- **`partials/` 없음** — 모두 `components/`로 통일

## Admin 영역

- 진입: `admin/index.php` (로그인 폼) — 부트스트랩 직접 require
- 라우팅: closure 라우터 **사용 안 함**, **물리 경로 PHP 파일 = URL** (`/admin/pages/works/edit.php`)
- 인증 가드: 페이지 상단 `require_once .../admin/lib/auth/admin.check.php` (`AdminSessionManager::requireLoginRedirect()`)
- 구조: `Controller/`, `Model/` (예: `WorkController/Model`), `pages/<area>/{index,new,edit}.php`, `pages/<area>/ajax/*.php`, `lib/` (Validator, AdminListSort, AdminJsonResponse, PageContext, Role, WorksAdminHelpers), `inc/` (head/header/drawer/footer fragment), `config/menu.config.php`
- CSS/JS: `admin/resource/` (공개 SCSS 파이프라인과 분리)

## API

- `api/works.php`만 존재. Works 관련 모든 엔드포인트 + `get_work_detail()` 등 헬퍼를 한 파일에. `routes/web.php`의 `$loadWorksApi` closure가 lazy require.

## 마이그레이션 시스템

**두 트랙 공존:**
1. **PHP 마이그레이터 (메인)**: `src/Database/Migrator.php`, CLI `php src/Database/migrate.php`. 추적 테이블 `nb_migrations`. 파일: `src/Database/migrations/YYYYMMDD_HHMMSS_<name>.php` (각 파일 `up()`/`down()` + `$db->exec(...)`)
2. **SQL 보조**: `database/migrations/*.sql` (수동 적용용 스니펫/백업)

- Makefile 없음 (`.claude/rules/php.md`의 `make m`는 표기일 뿐)
- 실제: `php src/Database/migrate.php` 또는 `/migration` skill
- DB 덤프: `database/<날짜>.sql`

## nb_ 테이블 목록

`init_database_schema.php` + 후속 마이그레이션 기준:
`nb_roles`, `nb_branches`, `nb_admin`, `nb_siteinfo`, `nb_branch_seos`, `nb_popups`, `nb_clients`, `nb_faqs`, `nb_board_manage`, `nb_board`, `nb_board_category`, `nb_board_comment`, `nb_board_lev_manage`, `nb_request`, `nb_site_tags`, `nb_works`, `nb_works_sort_no_undo`, `nb_migrations`, `nb_test`

**드롭됨**: `nb_privacy_policy`, `nb_banners`, `nb_category` (`database/migrations/20260405~06_drop_*.sql`)

## 추가 메모

- 이미지 출력은 반드시 `render_uploaded_image()` (`config/functions.php:160`) 경유. 첫 인자는 raw URL — 이중 escape 주의.
- 라우트 그룹 패턴: `$router->group(['prefix'=>'/works'], fn($r) => ...)`
- `Application::handleRequest()`에 로케일 prefix 감지 로직 존재하나 현재 비활성
- composer PSR-4: Core/Database/Http/Routing/View/Menu/Mail. Admin/Bootstrap는 `inc/lib/base.class.php`에서 수동 require

**Why:** 두 라우팅 트랙 (closure + physical-path admin), 두 마이그레이션 트랙 (PHP + SQL), 두 src 로딩 (PSR-4 + manual)이 공존해서 어디 무엇이 있는지 빠른 참조 필요.
**How to apply:** 새 공개 페이지 = closure routes. 새 admin 페이지 = `admin/pages/<area>/`. 새 API = `api/works.php` 패턴 따라 단일 파일 또는 lazy require closure. DB 변경 = `/migration` skill.

---
name: SCSS 아키텍처 딥맵
description: resource/scss/ 구조, fluid/mq 함수, 브레이크포인트, root 토큰, 컴포넌트 목록, 레이어 우선순위
type: project
---
NINEONELABS의 SCSS 시스템 — `resource/scss/` 전체.

## 디렉토리 & 레이어 우선순위

엔트리: `resource/scss/style.scss` — `@layer` + `meta.load-css()`. 순서:
**reset < base < layout < components < pages < utilities < state**

| Dir | 주요 파일 | 역할 |
|---|---|---|
| `abstract/` | `index, _variables, _colors, _functions, _mixins, _headings` | 헬퍼 함수, 믹스인, 색상/타이포 맵 |
| `base/` | `index, _fonts, _init, _reset, _root, _utils` | 글로벌 reset, :root 토큰, author 모드 셀렉터 |
| `components/` | 23개 + `hud/` 서브 | UI 컴포넌트별 스타일 |
| `layouts/` | `_header, _drawer, _footer` | 전역 레이아웃 |
| `pages/` | `_main, _sub, _works-canvas` | 페이지 고유 |
| `state/` | `_reveal-state` | TS-driven `[data-mask]`, `[data-reveal]`, `is-*` |

## abstract/ 핵심 헬퍼

**_functions.scss:**
- `fluid($y1, $y2, $x1: 375, $x2: 1920)` → `clamp(min, vw + base, max)` 반환
- `minus-fluid(...)` → 음수 버전
- `pxToRem($px)` → `$px * 0.1rem` (35 → 3.5rem)

**_mixins.scss:**
- `mq($key-or-size, $direction: "max")` → media query
- `mq-min()`, `mq-max()` 방향 래퍼
- `@mixin font($name)` → `@include font("ds-heading-1")` (`$fluid-typography` 자동 참조)
- `set-fluid($map)`, `section-fluid-by-map($map)`, `fs-fluid-by-map($map)`, `fs-static-by-map($map)`
- 패턴 헬퍼: `flex-center()`, `pos-full()`, `pos-center()`, `img-cover()`, `line-clamp()`, `blind()`

**_variables.scss:**
- `$font-familys` — Pretendard, ClashDisplay-Variable, Orbitron, Geist Mono
- `$containers` — xs(375), sm(544), md(768), lg(1024), xl(1440), 2xl(1640), 3xl(1920)
- `$gutters` — 3xs~4xl. `var(--gutter-md)` 등으로 사용
- `$sections` — section padding fluid 맵 (xl, lg, md, sm, footer)
- `$fluid-customs` — 커스텀 fluid 맵

**_headings.scss:**
- `$fluid-displays` (x, 0, 1_5, 1, 2) — min 42~48 / max 80~136
- `$fluid-headings` (1~5) — min 16~24 / max 24~48
- `$fluid-bodys` (1~5) — min 10~15 / max 12~20
- `$fluid-typography` — 위 셋 통합 (font() 진입점)

**_colors.scss:**
- `$theme-colors-light` / `$theme-colors-dark` — primitives + tokens (text, border, background)
- `theme-colors-flat()` 평탄화

## 브레이크포인트 (mq key → px)

```
xs: 375  /  sm: 544  /  md: 768  /  lg: 1024
xl: 1440 / 2xl: 1640 / 3xl: 1920
```
`mq($key)` → `(max-width: ...px)` / `mq-min($key)` → `(min-width: ...px)`

## base/_root.scss — 핵심 :root 토큰 (~200개)

| 카테고리 | 토큰 예시 |
|---|---|
| Typography | `--base-font-size`, `--base-line-height`, `--base-letter-spacing` (fluid) |
| Layout | `--header-height`, `--hud-unit`, `--gutter-3xs`~`--gutter-4xl`, `--gutter-container` |
| Z-index | `--z-index-bg` (-1) ~ `--z-index-custom-cursor` (2147483647) |
| Form | `--input-height`, `--form-file-action-size`, `--form-control-transition`, `--form-choice-*` |
| Duration | `--duration-instant` (0.1s) ~ `--duration-slower` (1s), `--duration-stagger` (0.08s) |
| Easing | `--ease-default`, `--ease-spring`, `--ease-bounce` |
| Motion | `--block-reveal-offset-y` (18px), `--text-reveal-offset-y` (4px) |
| Shadow | `--shadow-floating-card` |
| Scrollbar | `--scrollbar-width` (fluid) |
| Shiny CTA | `--shiny-cta-bg`, `--shiny-cta-fg`, `--shiny-cta-highlight` |
| Color | `--clr-text-*`, `--clr-border-*`, `--clr-background-*` (color 맵 flat) |

**다른 base 파일:**
- `_reset.scss` — `*` margin/padding 0 + box-sizing border-box, html `font-size: 62.5%`, body word-break: keep-all
- `_init.scss` — 전역 0값 처리 (중복 제거 금지)
- `_utils.scss` — `html[data-*-mode="author"]` (Theatre Studio author 모드)
- `_fonts.scss` — @import 글꼴

## components/ 목록

| 파일 | 주요 클래스 |
|---|---|
| `_button.scss` | `.no-btn`, `.no-btn-char`, `.shiny-cta`, `.no-magnetic-corner-btn`, `.no-wizard` |
| `_form.scss` | `.no-form-*`, `.no-form-reveal` |
| `_modal.scss` | `.no-modal` |
| `_panel.scss` | `.no-panel` |
| `_dropdown.scss` | `.no-dropdown` |
| `_search-bar.scss` | `.no-search-bar` |
| `_intro.scss` | `.intro` |
| `_loading.scss` | `.no-loading` |
| `_marquee.scss` | `.marquee` |
| `_masking-text.scss` | `.masking-text`, `.mask-target` |
| `_pagination.scss` | `.no-pagination` |
| `_table.scss` | `.no-table` |
| `_toast.scss` | `.toast` |
| `_hud-panel.scss` | `.hud-panel` |
| `_meta.scss` | `.meta` |
| `_category.scss` | `.category` |
| `_corner-bracket.scss` | (deprecated — `.no-corner-bracket` 실 요소 사용) |
| `_custom-cursor.scss` | `.custom-cursor` |
| `_space-card.scss` | `.space-card` |
| `_backdrop.scss` | `.backdrop` |
| `_detail-view.scss` | `.detail-view` |
| `_detail-prevnext.scss` | `.detail-prevnext` |
| `_prevnext.scss` | `.prevnext` |
| `_loop-filter-rect.scss` | `.loop-filter-rect` |
| `hud/_gauge.scss` | `.gauge` |

## layouts/

| 파일 | 클래스 | z-index |
|---|---|---|
| `_header.scss` | `.no-header` | 280 |
| `_drawer.scss` | `.no-drawer` | 270 |
| `_footer.scss` | `.footer` | — |

## pages/ & state/

- `pages/_main.scss` — 메인 (`.canvas-container`, `.main-content`)
- `pages/_sub.scss` — 서브 (작품 상세 등)
- `pages/_works-canvas.scss` — Works 캔버스 전용
- `state/_reveal-state.scss` — `[data-mask="ready"]`, `[data-reveal=inview|down|hidden]`

## 사용 규칙 요약

| 룰 | 비고 |
|---|---|
| `@use "../abstract" as *;` | 컴포넌트/페이지/레이아웃 외부 파일 필수 |
| `var(--token, fallback)` 금지 | 토큰 이름만 사용 |
| `fluid(min, max)` 직접 호출 | 컴포넌트/페이지 안 |
| `#{fluid(...)}` interpolation | abstract/base 안에서만 |
| `@include font("...")` | 타이포그래피 적용 |
| `mq($key)` | 반응형 |
| `.is-*` / `[data-*]` | TS-driven 상태 |
| 0값 중복 제거 금지 | _init.scss에 이미 있음 |

**Why:** 토큰·fluid·mq 시스템이 강하게 표준화되어 있어서 임의 값을 쓰면 디자인 시스템 일관성이 깨짐.
**How to apply:** 새 SCSS 추가 시 (1) 적합한 디렉토리 선택 → (2) abstract/base 토큰 먼저 검색 → (3) 없으면 abstract에 추가하고 컴포넌트에서 사용. 신규 토큰은 단일 컴포넌트면 만들지 말고 fluid()/var(--token) 직접 사용.

lastPrompt: 너가 앞으로 작업을 할 때 내 문서를 디테일하게 봐야하니까 전체가 낫지 않겠니

- `_init.scss` — 전역 0값 처리 (중복 제거 금지)
- `_utils.scss` — `html[data-*-mode="author"]` (Theatre Studio author 모드)
- `_fonts.scss` — @import 글꼴

## components/ 목록

| 파일 | 주요 클래스 |
|---|---|
| `_button.scss` | `.no-btn`, `.no-btn-char`, `.shiny-cta`, `.no-magnetic-corner-btn`, `.no-wizard` |
| `_form.scss` | `.no-form-*`, `.no-form-reveal` |
| `_modal.scss` | `.no-modal` |
| `_panel.scss` | `.no-panel` |
| `_dropdown.scss` | `.no-dropdown` |
| `_search-bar.scss` | `.no-search-bar` |
| `_intro.scss` | `.intro` |
| `_loading.scss` | `.no-loading` |
| `_marquee.scss` | `.marquee` |
| `_masking-text.scss` | `.masking-text`, `.mask-target` |
| `_pagination.scss` | `.no-pagination` |
| `_table.scss` | `.no-table` |
| `_toast.scss` | `.toast` |
| `_hud-panel.scss` | `.hud-panel` |
| `_meta.scss` | `.meta` |
| `_category.scss` | `.category` |
| `_corner-bracket.scss` | (deprecated — `.no-corner-bracket` 실 요소 사용) |
| `_custom-cursor.scss` | `.custom-cursor` |
| `_space-card.scss` | `.space-card` |
| `_backdrop.scss` | `.backdrop` |
| `_detail-view.scss` | `.detail-view` |
| `_detail-prevnext.scss` | `.detail-prevnext` |
| `_prevnext.scss` | `.prevnext` |
| `_loop-filter-rect.scss` | `.loop-filter-rect` |
| `hud/_gauge.scss` | `.gauge` |

## layouts/

| 파일 | 클래스 | z-index |
|---|---|---|
| `_header.scss` | `.no-header` | 280 |
| `_drawer.scss` | `.no-drawer` | 270 |
| `_footer.scss` | `.footer` | — |

## pages/ & state/

- `pages/_main.scss` — 메인 (`.canvas-container`, `.main-content`)
- `pages/_sub.scss` — 서브 (작품 상세 등)
- `pages/_works-canvas.scss` — Works 캔버스 전용
- `state/_reveal-state.scss` — `[data-mask="ready"]`, `[data-reveal=inview|down|hidden]`

## 사용 규칙 요약

| 룰 | 비고 |
|---|---|
| `@use "../abstract" as *;` | 컴포넌트/페이지/레이아웃 외부 파일 필수 |
| `var(--token, fallback)` 금지 | 토큰 이름만 사용 |
| `fluid(min, max)` 직접 호출 | 컴포넌트/페이지 안 |
| `#{fluid(...)}` interpolation | abstract/base 안에서만 |
| `@include font("...")` | 타이포그래피 적용 |
| `mq($key)` | 반응형 |
| `.is-*` / `[data-*]` | TS-driven 상태 |
| 0값 중복 제거 금지 | _init.scss에 이미 있음 |

**Why:** 토큰·fluid·mq 시스템이 강하게 표준화되어 있어서 임의 값을 쓰면 디자인 시스템 일관성이 깨짐.
**How to apply:** 새 SCSS 추가 시 (1) 적합한 디렉토리 선택 → (2) abstract/base 토큰 먼저 검색 → (3) 없으면 abstract에 추가하고 컴포넌트에서 사용. 신규 토큰은 단일 컴포넌트면 만들지 말고 fluid()/var(--token) 직접 사용.

paths:

---

# Frontend Rules

- Bundler: Vite / Language: TypeScript (ES6+)
- 3D: Three.js — follow existing patterns in `resource/ts/`
- **Do NOT run `npm run build`, `npm run watch`, or `npm install`**
  - Reason: Vite dev server at `http://localhost:8888` auto-bundles on every file save
  - Only `npm install <package>` is allowed when adding a new dependency
  - Do not include these commands in verification steps, PR notes, or agent plans

## TypeScript

- All types/interfaces/enums → `resource/ts/types/*.types.ts` only — no inline types, no `any`
- All constants, colors, sizes, URLs → config files only — no magic numbers
- Page theatre: `resource/ts/pages/<page>/theatre/`
- Page scene: `resource/ts/pages/<page>/scene/`
- Shared engine/runtime code stays out of page folders

## Three.js

- `dispose()` required for every geometry, material, texture
- No object creation inside render loop
- `addEventListener` must have matching `removeEventListener`
- No monkey-patching Three.js API

content.content: 1 --- 2 paths: 3 - "**/*.php" 4 --- 5 6 # PHP Rules 7 8 - Framework: custom MVC (PHP 7.4) — no Laravel/Symfony conventions 9 - Namespaces: `Core\`, `Database\`, `Http\`, `Routing\`, `View\`, `Menu\` 10 - Classes: PascalCase / Methods & variables: camelCase / Constants: UPPER_SNAKE_CASE 11 - DB tables use `nb_` prefix (e.g. `nb_siteinfo`, `nb_admin`) 12 - DB schema changes must go through migration files (`make m`), never alter tables directly 13 14 ## Patterns 15 16 ```php 17 // Routing 18 $router->get('/', function () { 19 return render('pages.index'); 20 })->name('home'); 21 22 // View rendering 23 render('pages.index'); // views/pages/index.php 24 render('pages.works.view', ['no' => $no]); // views/pages/works/view.php 25 ``` 26 27 ## Image Upload & WEBP Optimization 28 29 All Admin image uploads flow through `imageUpload()` in `inc/lib/func.php`. 30 After saving, it automatically calls `\Core\ImageProcessor::makeWebpSibling()`. 31 32 ```php 33 // Standard upload call — WEBP sibling is created automatically 34 $result = imageUpload($UPLOAD_DIR_CLIENTS, $_FILES['thumb_image']); 35 $saved = $result['saved']; // e.g. "6830abc.png" — DB stores this, foo.webp created alongside 36 37 // If you add a NEW upload path that bypasses imageUpload(), call manually: 38 move_uploaded_file($tmp, "$dir/$filename"); 39 \Core\ImageProcessor::makeWebpSibling("$dir/$filename"); 40 41 // Deletion — imageDelete() handles sibling cleanup automatically 42 imageDelete("$UPLOAD_DIR_CLIENTS/$saved"); // removes .png + .webp 43 ``` 44 45 Rules: 46 - Do not add image resize/convert logic outside `Core\ImageProcessor`. 47 - `makeWebpSibling()` is silent on failure — never throw from it. 48 - Convertible: `jpg`, `jpeg`, `png`, `gif`. Skipped: `svg`, `ico`. 49 - Max width: 2560px (auto-resize). 4	---
5	
6	# SCSS Rules
7	
8	- Use BEM pattern for class naming
9	- Source: `resource/scss/` → compiled output: `resource/dist/`
10	- Do NOT run build commands — dev server reflects changes on save automatically
11	
12	## Token Contract
13	
14	- Reusable tokens → `resource/scss/abstract/` or `base/_root.scss`
15	- Use `var(--clr-*)`, `var(--duration-*)` etc. in consumers — no raw hex when semantic token exists upstream
16	- Admin CSS (`admin/resource/css/`) is separate — do not import from public SCSS entry
17	
18	## Reset / Init Contract

# SCSS Rules

- Use BEM pattern for class naming
- Source: `resource/scss/` → compiled output: `resource/dist/`
- Do NOT run build commands — dev server reflects changes on save automatically

## Token Contract

- Reusable tokens → `resource/scss/abstract/` or `base/_root.scss`
- Use `var(--clr-*)`, `var(--duration-*)` etc. in consumers — no raw hex when semantic token exists upstream
- Admin CSS (`admin/resource/css/`) is separate — do not import from public SCSS entry

## Reset / Init Contract

`_init.scss`가 다음을 전역 적용함 — 컴포넌트/페이지 SCSS에서 단독 중복 선언 금지:
- `margin: 0` → `*` selector로 이미 0
- `padding: 0` → `*` selector로 이미 0
- `list-style: none` → `ul, ol, li`에 이미 없음
- `padding-left: 0` / `padding-right: 0` 등 단일 축 0도 동일하게 금지
  (단, 직상위 규칙에서 해당 축에 non-zero 값이 선언되어 있으면 예외)

`@include font("...")` mixin은 `font-size`, `line-height`, `letter-spacing`을 모두 출력함.
mixin 호출 직후 동일 값으로 개별 재선언하지 않는다.

27	| `manager/BackgroundManager.ts` | 730 | Env + uniforms + transitions | Acceptable (single rendering concern) |
28	
29	**Healthy coordinators (do not touch):**
30	- `core/Scene.ts`, `core/PageTheatreBinder.ts`, `runtime/PageRuntime.ts` — clean single-purpose orchestrators.
31	- All `types/*.types.ts` — 19 files organized by domain.
32	- All `config/*.config.ts` — constants only, no logic.
33	
34	**Claude rule:** Do not grow the god objects above. New features belong in new runtime/coordinator classes next to them.
35	
36	## A2. How to extend — adding a new feature
37	
38	### Decision tree
39	
40	```
41	New feature needed
42	│
43	├─ Is it a visible 3D object?           → resource/ts/objects/<env|sub|main|rocket|shared>/
44	│                                         Extends SceneObject<TweenProps>
45	│
46	├─ Is it DOM UI (header, modal, form)?  → resource/ts/ui/ or resource/ts/components/
47	│                                         Must implement init() + dispose()
48	│
49	├─ Is it page-scoped runtime state?     → resource/ts/pages/<page>/runtime/
50	│
51	├─ Is it Theatre.js binding for a page? → resource/ts/pages/<page>/theatre/
52	│                                         Register in PageTheatreBinder factory map
53	│
54	├─ Is it a cross-page orchestrator?     → resource/ts/runtime/ or resource/ts/manager/
55	│                                         Needs strong justification
56	│
57	├─ Is it a shader / material?           → resource/shaders/ + referenced from objects/
58	│
59	└─ Is it a constant / color / URL?      → resource/ts/config/<domain>.config.ts
60	                                          NOT inline
61	```
62	
63	### New scene object checklist
64	
65	1. File: `objects/<group>/YourObject.ts` extending `SceneObject<YourTweenProps>`.
66	2. Implement `runObject()`, `runUpdate(dt)`, `dispose()`, `applyVisibility()`.
67	3. Type: `YourObjectOptions` + `YourTweenProps` in `types/object.types.ts` (not inline).
68	4. Config: constants in `config/<group>.config.ts`.
69	5. Dispose: every allocated geometry/material/texture goes through `utils/disposeObject3D.ts` or `SceneObject._ownedTextures`.
70	6. Registration: `ObjectSetup.ts` for instance + optional `registerObject(id, ...)` for cross-object lookup.
71	
72	### New DOM component checklist
73	
74	1. File: `ui/YourComponent.ts` (singletons) or `components/YourComponent.ts` (reusable widgets).
75	2. Static `init({ root })` + static `dispose()` pair. If multiple instances, keep a `Set<Instance>` and iterate in `dispose()`.
76	3. All event listeners: store bound handlers as fields, remove the same references in `dispose()`.
77	4. Timers: track via `Set<number>` + helper `_trackedTimeout`. Clear all in `dispose()`.
78	5. Web Animations API: track via `Set<Animation>` + helper `_trackAnimation`. Cancel all in `dispose()`.
79	6. Hook into `PageRuntime.dispose()` so page navigation tears down cleanly.
80	7. Options/data types → `types/component.types.ts`.
81	8. CSS class names / selectors → `config/component.config.ts` or `config/dom.config.ts`.
82	
83	### New page route checklist
84	
85	Use `/new-route` skill. Adds:
86	- `routes/web.php` closure route
87	- `views/pages/<page>.php` view
88	- Optional `resource/ts/pages/<page>/` entry
89	
90	## A3. Roles
91	
92	| Folder | Role | What lives here | What does NOT |
93	|---|---|---|---|
94	| `core/` | Engine + scene + lifecycle primitives | `Engine`, `Scene`, `AnimationLoop`, `PostProcessor`, `ModelLoader`, `PageTheatreBinder`, `SceneObject` base | Page-specific logic |
95	| `runtime/` | Cross-cutting app-level state machines | `PageRuntime`, `ResponsiveRuntime`, `IntroFlowRuntime`, `ScrollSceneRuntime`, `TimelineRuntime` | Per-page scenes |
96	| `manager/` | Heavyweight orchestrators | `AppManager` (to be split), `BackgroundManager`, `QaManager`, `IntroManager`, `ShaderManager` | New single-responsibility code (prefer `runtime/` or `core/`) |
97	| `pages/<page>/runtime/` | Per-page lifecycle | Page-specific scroll, intro, interaction runtimes | Code shared across pages |
98	| `pages/<page>/scene/` | Per-page THREE.js scene graph wiring | Object composition specific to the page | Generic scene objects |
99	| `pages/<page>/theatre/` | Per-page Theatre.js bindings | `*TheatreBridge`, `*TheatreRuntime`, `*SceneState` | DOM-only logic |
100	| `pages/<page>/render/` | Per-page standalone renderers (rare) | `WorksSceneManager` style secondary renderers | Main engine scenes |
101	| `objects/` | THREE.js scene objects | Classes extending `SceneObject` | DOM elements |
102	| `ui/` | DOM singletons | `Header`, `Drawer`, `ContactWizard`, `WorkModal`, `IntroCanvas` | Reusable widgets (go to `components/`) |
103	| `components/` | Reusable DOM widgets | `Button`, `Marquee`, `CustomCursor`, `TextReveal`, `WhySkillPreview` | Scene objects |
104	| `animation/` | Non-GSAP DOM animation primitives | `TextReveal`, `BlockReveal` base | 3D tweens |
105	| `builder/` | Declarative composition engines | `TimelineBuilder` | Runtime state |
106	| `validation/` | Form/input validation | `ContactFormValidation` | Business logic |
107	| `utils/` | Pure leaf helpers | `disposeObject3D`, `Debounce`, `FrameScheduler`, `Aria`, `Helpers` | Stateful managers |
108	| `config/` | Constants only | colors, selectors, durations, URLs | Any logic |
109	| `types/` | Type definitions only | `*.types.ts` per domain | Runtime code |
110	| `app/` | Bootstrap entry | `AppBootstrap`, `ObjectSetup`, `EnvSetup` | Feature code |
111	| `lib/` | Third-party wrappers | Theatre.js, Lenis wrappers | Domain code |
112	
113	Every file must fit one row. If it fits none, stop and reconsider the design.
114	
115	## A4. OOP / SOLID checklist for new code
116	
117	Run through this list mentally before writing the class.
118	
119	### SRP — Single Responsibility
120	- One "reason to change" per class. If you need "and" to describe it, split.
121	- If > 400 lines, ask whether 2+ smaller classes fit better.
122	- **New code must not be added to `AppManager` or `ContactWizard`.** Extend in a sibling class.
123	
124	### OCP — Open/Closed
125	- New page variants → add to factory map (`PageTheatreBinder.PAGE_THEATRE_ADAPTER_FACTORIES`), never a new `if (pageId === ...)` branch.
126	- New light/object types → register in a creator map (`SceneLights._creators` pattern), never a switch.
127	- Use the `ObjectFactoryRegistry` for new scene-object kinds.
128	
129	### LSP — Liskov Substitution
130	- Subclasses of `SceneObject` must respect the contract: `init` → `runObject` → `runUpdate` → `dispose`, no partial cycles.
131	- `override` keyword is mandatory on overridden methods.
132	
133	### ISP — Interface Segregation
134	- Adapter interfaces are split by capability (`PageTheatreBootAdapter`, `PageTheatrePreviewAdapter`, `PageTheatreIntroAdapter`, `PageTheatreIntroActionAdapter`, `PageTheatreSceneSyncAdapter`).
135	- Implement only the capabilities you need; the composite `PageTheatreAdapter` is optional-by-field.
136	- Do not add fields to existing interfaces just to avoid a type check — add a narrower interface.
137	
138	### DIP — Dependency Inversion
139	- `Engine` accepts `EngineDependencies` (`sceneFactory`, `modelLoaderFactory`). Use this for testing/swapping.
140	- High-level modules must not `new ConcreteClass()` mid-constructor when a factory slot exists.
141	- Cross-class lookup goes through `context.getObject(id)` (O(1)), never `scene.getObjectByName(...)` (O(n)).
142	
143	### Disposal symmetry
144	Every class that allocates is responsible for releasing:
145	
146	| Creates | Must release in `dispose()` |
147	|---|---|
148	| `addEventListener` | `removeEventListener` with same reference + options |
149	| `setTimeout` / `setInterval` | `clearTimeout` / `clearInterval` |
150	| `requestAnimationFrame` | `cancelAnimationFrame` |
151	| `new MutationObserver` / Intersection / Resize | `.disconnect()` |
152	| `THREE.BufferGeometry` | `.dispose()` |
153	| `THREE.Material` | `.dispose()` + all texture slots |
154	| `THREE.Texture` | `.dispose()` — or register via `SceneObject._ownedTextures` |
155	| `THREE.Light` | `.parent?.remove(light)` + `light.dispose?.()` + target removal |
156	| `Element.animate()` | `.cancel()` |
157	| Debounce / scheduler | `.offCancel()` |
158	| Theatre subscription | Call returned unsubscribe |
159	| Scene pub/sub subscription | Call returned unsubscribe |
160	
161	Use the helpers:
162	- `utils/disposeObject3D.ts` — traverses an Object3D, disposes geometries + materials (with all 21 texture slots + shader uniform textures).
163	- `utils/disposeObject3D.ts#removeAndDispose(node)` — detach from parent and dispose.
164	
165	### Side effects
166	- Constructors: wiring only. No DOM queries, no RAF, no fetches, no listener registration. Do it in `init()`/`mount()`.
167	- Module top-level: no side effects. No `window.addEventListener` at import time. No singletons created at import time.
168	- Static fields: no mutable state. If you need tracking (e.g., `ContactWizard._instances`), it must be reset by a static `dispose()`.
169	
170	## A5. THREE.js GPU/CPU optimization playbook
171	
172	### Render-loop hot path rules (hard bans)
173	
174	1. **No `new Vector2/Vector3/Matrix4/Quaternion/Euler` inside `runUpdate`, `render`, or any per-frame callback.**
175	   - Use module-scope or instance `_scratch` fields. Mutate with `.copy()`, `.set()`, `.applyMatrix4()`.
176	2. **No object literals inside per-frame paths.**
177	   - Cache resolved options in an instance scratch object. Recompute only when inputs change (in `setOptions`, not in `runUpdate`).
178	3. **No `scene.getObjectByName()` per frame.** Use `context.getObject(id)` (O(1) Map lookup) or subscribe via `Scene.onObjectRegistered`.
179	4. **No `new Set()` / `Object.keys()` / `Array.from()` inside hot path.** Pre-compute key arrays when source changes.
180	5. **No `.getSnapshot()` called more than once per frame.** Cache locally in the function.
181	6. **No `uniform.tX.value = texture` per frame.** Textures set once at material creation; only scalars/vectors update per frame.
182	
183	### World matrix freshness
184	
185	- Before reading `object.matrixWorld` or `object.getWorldPosition()`, call `object.updateWorldMatrix(true, false)` if the render hasn't run yet this frame.
186	- Known call sites that already do this: `Engine._resolveFollowAnchor`, `CameraTargetRuntime.resolveFollowAnchor`, `CloudPlane._applyRocketUniforms`.
187	
188	### GPU memory
189	
190	- Every cached model must be cloned with independent materials. `ModelLoader.loadGLTF` handles this via `_cloneMaterialsInPlace` — don't bypass.
191	- Shader swaps on cached meshes must guard against re-application. Use `userData.__<name>Applied` tag (see `Ground._applyGroundShader`).
192	- On page teardown: `Engine.dispose()` → `Scene.dispose()` → every `SceneObject.dispose()` → `disposeObject3D(timelineRoot)`.
193	- Secondary renderers (like `WorksSceneManager`): must call `renderer.dispose()` AND `renderer.forceContextLoss()`.
194	
195	### Materials / shaders
196	
197	- Clone materials before mutation to avoid cache pollution: `material.clone()`.
198	- `onBeforeCompile` closures must not retain frame-local state. Store uniform refs in `userData.shader` for later mutation.
199	- `needsUpdate = true` is set exactly once (after `onBeforeCompile` assignment). Never in the render loop.
200	
201	### Post-processing
202	
203	- `EffectComposer.setSize(w, h)` receives CSS pixels (composer applies pixel ratio internally).
204	- `UnrealBloomPass.resolution.set(w, h)` receives CSS pixels (matches composer).
205	- Do not call `renderer.setSize()` inside the render loop. Use a resize listener → `ResponsiveRuntime` dispatch.
206	
207	### Profiling
208	
209	- Chrome DevTools Performance → look for frames > 16.67ms and GC sawteeth.
210	- `chrome://tracing` / WebGL Inspector for draw-call counts.
211	- Self-check: 60fps with GC events < 2/sec. Allocation profiler should show ~0 new Vector2/Vector3/Object per frame.
212	
213	## A6. Responsive architecture
214	
215	The project centralizes all responsive state through `ResponsiveRuntime` (pub/sub). Build new responsive features on top of it; do not add ad-hoc `window.matchMedia` listeners.
216	
217	### Contract
218	
219	```ts
220	const runtime = ResponsiveRuntime.getDefault();
221	const snapshot = runtime.getSnapshot();
222	// snapshot.breakpoint: "sm" | "md" | "lg" | "xl"
223	// snapshot.viewportWidth / viewportHeight
224	// snapshot.render.clampedPixelRatio
225	// snapshot.device.isMobile
226	// snapshot.reducedMotion
227	// snapshot.performance tier
228	
229	const unsubscribe = runtime.subscribe((next) => {
230	  // react to breakpoint / viewport / reduced motion changes
231	});
232	// In dispose(): unsubscribe();
233	```
234	
235	### Extension rules
236	
237	- **New responsive value:** derive from `snapshot` inside the consumer. Don't add fields to `ResponsiveSnapshot` unless multiple consumers need it.
238	- **Config with breakpoint variance:** use `utils/ResponsiveValue.ts` (`{ sm, md, lg, xl, default }`) — declare in `config/`, resolve at call site.
239	- **Reduced motion:** check `snapshot.reducedMotion` and provide a degraded path (no infinite loops, no parallax). Required for accessibility.
240	- **Pixel ratio / performance tier:** read `snapshot.render.clampedPixelRatio` and `snapshot.performance` — used by `Engine` and `PostProcessor` automatically. Pass the snapshot through, don't re-derive.
241	- **Orientation / mobile only:** prefer `snapshot.device.isMobile` over UA sniffing.
242	- **Three.js resizing:** single path. Resize listener → `ResponsiveRuntime.updateFromWindow()` → subscribers (`Engine.applyResponsiveSnapshot`, `PostProcessor.resize`, `WorksSceneManager`). Do not bind `window.resize` in new code.
243	
244	### CSS integration
245	
246	- `ResponsiveRuntime._applyCssVariables(snapshot)` publishes CSS custom properties. Read them in SCSS via `var(--vw, 1vw)` etc., not through JS-computed inline styles.
247	
248	### Touch vs hover
249	
250	- Hover UX (`mouseenter` / `mouseleave`) stays on `MouseEvent` semantics — it's desktop-only by design.
251	- Drag / press / click target → `PointerEvent` (`pointerdown` / `pointerup` / `pointermove`) with `pointerId` tracking. See `CustomCursor` and `WorksPageRuntime` patterns.
252	
253	### Anti-patterns (do not ship)
254	
255	- Inline `@media` in TypeScript conditions (`if (window.innerWidth < 768)`). Use the snapshot.
256	- `matchMedia` listener per component. Use `ResponsiveRuntime.subscribe`.
257	- Hardcoded breakpoint numbers in TS. Source them from `config/` or from `snapshot.breakpoint`.
258	- Fighting against `prefers-reduced-motion` (autoplay, infinite animations). Respect it.
259	
260	---
261	
262	# Part B — Claude Code Harness Checklist
263	
264	Token efficiency and configuration health checklist for this project.
265	
266	---
267	
268	## 1. CLAUDE.md
269	
270	- [ ] Under 50 lines?
271	- [ ] Does not contain anything Claude can infer from reading the code (file structure, naming conventions, etc.)?
272	- [ ] File-type rules are separated into `.claude/rules/`?
273	- [ ] Explicit "do not" prohibition patterns listed?
274	- [ ] Verification commands included (tsc, lint, test, etc.)?
275	
276	## 2. Rules (`.claude/rules/`)
277	
278	- [ ] Split by file extension? (`php.md`, `frontend.md`, `scss.md`)
279	- [ ] Each rules file has a `paths:` frontmatter header?
280	- [ ] Rules contain only things that cannot be inferred from the code?
281	
282	## 3. Hooks (`.claude/settings.json`)
283	
284	- [ ] Auto-runs tsc after editing a `.ts` file?
285	- [ ] Hook verified to actually fire by editing a `.ts` file?
286	- [ ] Frequently used safe commands registered in `allowedTools`?
287	
288	## 4. Skills (`.claude/skills/`)
289	
290	- [ ] Repeatable workflows packaged as skills?
291	- [ ] Project-specific workflows like `/migration`, `/new-route` defined?
292	
293	## 5. Subagents (`.claude/agents/`)
294	
295	- [ ] Exploration agents available for read-heavy tasks?
296	- [ ] Three.js scene exploration delegated to `scene-explorer` agent?
297	- [ ] PHP structure exploration delegated to `php-explorer` agent?
298	
299	## 6. Session habits
300	
301	- [ ] Using `/clear` between unrelated tasks?
302	- [ ] After two failed corrections, starting fresh with `/clear` + better prompt?
303	- [ ] Protecting main context by asking "use a subagent to investigate"?
304	- [ ] Resuming long sessions with `--continue` / `--resume`?
305	
306	## 7. Token waste patterns (fix immediately if found)
307	
308	- [ ] No docs/ folder accumulating content Claude can infer from code?
309	- [ ] CLAUDE.md not exceeding 50 lines?
310	- [ ] Claude prefixing Bash tool calls with `chop`? (verify with `chop gain`)
311	- [ ] `chop gain` count increasing? Zero means chop is not actually being used.
312	
313	---
314	
315	## Current project setup status
316	
317	| Item | Status |
318	| --- | --- |
319	| CLAUDE.md concise | ✅ |
320	| CLAUDE.md skill invocation examples | ✅ |
321	| Rules on-demand | ✅ php / frontend / scss |
322	| Hooks (tsc) | ✅ Node.js stdin pattern |
323	| Hook verified | ✅ Confirmed firing via Edit tool on .ts file |
324	| allowedTools | ✅ chop / git / tsc / docker / npm test |
325	| Skills | ✅ migration / new-route |
326	| Subagents | ✅ scene-explorer / php-explorer |
327	| docs/ removed + README cleaned | ✅ |
328	| spatie/image WEBP optimization | ✅ 1.10.6 (PHP 7.4 compat), ImageProcessor, dockerfile libwebp-dev |
329	| CHOP applied | ✅ |
330	| MEMORY.md | ✅ architecture / workflow / chop / npm / permissions |
331	| Test framework | ✅ vitest (19 tests) |
332	| --dangerously-skip-permissions | ✅ VS Code setting (allowDangerouslySkipPermissions) |
333	| npm build/watch/install forbidden | ✅ CLAUDE.md / AGENTS.md / frontend.md |
334	| All AI-read files in English | ✅ |
335	
336	## Permission setup — `allowDangerouslySkipPermissions`
337	
338	To prevent Claude Code from asking for permission on every action, enable via VS Code:
339	
340	1. Open **File → Preferences → Settings** (or `Ctrl+,`)
341	2. Search for `claudeCode.allowDangerouslySkipPermissions`
342	3. Check the box — this adds "Bypass permissions" to the mode cycle
343	
344	> **Warning:** This flag auto-approves all tool use: file writes, Bash execution, etc.
345	> Use only in trusted projects. Default permission mode is recommended for unfamiliar codebases.
346	
347	## Why npm build commands are forbidden
348	
349	`npm run build`, `npm run watch`, and `npm install` are **forbidden during normal development**.
350	
351	- **Reason:** Vite dev server at `http://localhost:8888` auto-rebuilds the bundle on every file save
352	- Running these wastes context and time with no benefit
353	- **Exception:** `npm install <package>` — only when explicitly adding a new dependency
354	- This rule is enforced in three places: CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md, and `.claude/rules/frontend.md`
355	
356	## How the tsc PostToolUse hook works
357	
358	When a `.ts` file is modified via the Edit or Write tool, the PostToolUse hook fires automatically:
359	
360	```bash
361	# Command executed by the hook
362	chop node_modules/.bin/tsc --noEmit
363	```
364	
365	- Hook config: `.claude/settings.json` → `PostToolUse` → matcher: `Edit|Write`
366	- If tsc errors are found, the hook returns `exit(1)`, immediately notifying Claude
367	- **How to verify:** Edit any `.ts` file with the Edit tool → check hook output for tsc results

- All `types/*.types.ts` — 19 files organized by domain.
- All `config/*.config.ts` — constants only, no logic.

**Claude rule:** Do not grow the god objects above. New features belong in new runtime/coordinator classes next to them.

## A2. How to extend — adding a new feature

### Decision tree

```
New feature needed
│
├─ Is it a visible 3D object?           → resource/ts/objects/<env|sub|main|rocket|shared>/
│                                         Extends SceneObject<TweenProps>
│
├─ Is it DOM UI (header, modal, form)?  → resource/ts/ui/ or resource/ts/components/
│                                         Must implement init() + dispose()
│
├─ Is it page-scoped runtime state?     → resource/ts/pages/<page>/runtime/
│
├─ Is it Theatre.js binding for a page? → resource/ts/pages/<page>/theatre/
│                                         Register in PageTheatreBinder factory map
│
├─ Is it a cross-page orchestrator?     → resource/ts/runtime/ or resource/ts/manager/
│                                         Needs strong justification
│
├─ Is it a shader / material?           → resource/shaders/ + referenced from objects/
│
└─ Is it a constant / color / URL?      → resource/ts/config/<domain>.config.ts
                                          NOT inline
```

### New scene object checklist

1. File: `objects/<group>/YourObject.ts` extending `SceneObject<YourTweenProps>`.
2. Implement `runObject()`, `runUpdate(dt)`, `dispose()`, `applyVisibility()`.
3. Type: `YourObjectOptions` + `YourTweenProps` in `types/object.types.ts` (not inline).
4. Config: constants in `config/<group>.config.ts`.
5. Dispose: every allocated geometry/material/texture goes through `utils/disposeObject3D.ts` or `SceneObject._ownedTextures`.
6. Registration: `ObjectSetup.ts` for instance + optional `registerObject(id, ...)` for cross-object lookup.

### New DOM component checklist

1. File: `ui/YourComponent.ts` (singletons) or `components/YourComponent.ts` (reusable widgets).
2. Static `init({ root })` + static `dispose()` pair. If multiple instances, keep a `Set<Instance>` and iterate in `dispose()`.
3. All event listeners: store bound handlers as fields, remove the same references in `dispose()`.
4. Timers: track via `Set<number>` + helper `_trackedTimeout`. Clear all in `dispose()`.
5. Web Animations API: track via `Set<Animation>` + helper `_trackAnimation`. Cancel all in `dispose()`.
6. Hook into `PageRuntime.dispose()` so page navigation tears down cleanly.
7. Options/data types → `types/component.types.ts`.
8. CSS class names / selectors → `config/component.config.ts` or `config/dom.config.ts`.

### New page route checklist

Use `/new-route` skill. Adds:
- `routes/web.php` closure route
- `views/pages/<page>.php` view
- Optional `resource/ts/pages/<page>/` entry

## A3. Roles

| Folder | Role | What lives here | What does NOT |
|---|---|---|---|
| `core/` | Engine + scene + lifecycle primitives | `Engine`, `Scene`, `AnimationLoop`, `PostProcessor`, `ModelLoader`, `PageTheatreBinder`, `SceneObject` base | Page-specific logic |
| `runtime/` | Cross-cutting app-level state machines | `PageRuntime`, `ResponsiveRuntime`, `IntroFlowRuntime`, `ScrollSceneRuntime`, `TimelineRuntime` | Per-page scenes |
| `manager/` | Heavyweight orchestrators | `AppManager` (to be split), `BackgroundManager`, `QaManager`, `IntroManager`, `ShaderManager` | New single-responsibility code (prefer `runtime/` or `core/`) |
| `pages/<page>/runtime/` | Per-page lifecycle | Page-specific scroll, intro, interaction runtimes | Code shared across pages |
| `pages/<page>/scene/` | Per-page THREE.js scene graph wiring | Object composition specific to the page | Generic scene objects |
| `pages/<page>/theatre/` | Per-page Theatre.js bindings | `*TheatreBridge`, `*TheatreRuntime`, `*SceneState` | DOM-only logic |
| `pages/<page>/render/` | Per-page standalone renderers (rare) | `WorksSceneManager` style secondary renderers | Main engine scenes |
| `objects/` | THREE.js scene objects | Classes extending `SceneObject` | DOM elements |
| `ui/` | DOM singletons | `Header`, `Drawer`, `ContactWizard`, `WorkModal`, `IntroCanvas` | Reusable widgets (go to `components/`) |
| `components/` | Reusable DOM widgets | `Button`, `Marquee`, `CustomCursor`, `TextReveal`, `WhySkillPreview` | Scene objects |
| `animation/` | Non-GSAP DOM animation primitives | `TextReveal`, `BlockReveal` base | 3D tweens |
| `builder/` | Declarative composition engines | `TimelineBuilder` | Runtime state |
| `validation/` | Form/input validation | `ContactFormValidation` | Business logic |
| `utils/` | Pure leaf helpers | `disposeObject3D`, `Debounce`, `FrameScheduler`, `Aria`, `Helpers` | Stateful managers |
| `config/` | Constants only | colors, selectors, durations, URLs | Any logic |
| `types/` | Type definitions only | `*.types.ts` per domain | Runtime code |
| `app/` | Bootstrap entry | `AppBootstrap`, `ObjectSetup`, `EnvSetup` | Feature code |
| `lib/` | Third-party wrappers | Theatre.js, Lenis wrappers | Domain code |

Every file must fit one row. If it fits none, stop and reconsider the design.

## A4. OOP / SOLID checklist for new code

Run through this list mentally before writing the class.

### SRP — Single Responsibility
- One "reason to change" per class. If you need "and" to describe it, split.
- If > 400 lines, ask whether 2+ smaller classes fit better.
- **New code must not be added to `AppManager` or `ContactWizard`.** Extend in a sibling class.

### OCP — Open/Closed
- New page variants → add to factory map (`PageTheatreBinder.PAGE_THEATRE_ADAPTER_FACTORIES`), never a new `if (pageId === ...)` branch.
- New light/object types → register in a creator map (`SceneLights._creators` pattern), never a switch.
- Use the `ObjectFactoryRegistry` for new scene-object kinds.

### LSP — Liskov Substitution
- Subclasses of `SceneObject` must respect the contract: `init` → `runObject` → `runUpdate` → `dispose`, no partial cycles.
- `override` keyword is mandatory on overridden methods.

### ISP — Interface Segregation
- Adapter interfaces are split by capability (`PageTheatreBootAdapter`, `PageTheatrePreviewAdapter`, `PageTheatreIntroAdapter`, `PageTheatreIntroActionAdapter`, `PageTheatreSceneSyncAdapter`).
- Implement only the capabilities you need; the composite `PageTheatreAdapter` is optional-by-field.
- Do not add fields to existing interfaces just to avoid a type check — add a narrower interface.

### DIP — Dependency Inversion
- `Engine` accepts `EngineDependencies` (`sceneFactory`, `modelLoaderFactory`). Use this for testing/swapping.
- High-level modules must not `new ConcreteClass()` mid-constructor when a factory slot exists.
- Cross-class lookup goes through `context.getObject(id)` (O(1)), never `scene.getObjectByName(...)` (O(n)).

### Disposal symmetry
Every class that allocates is responsible for releasing:

| Creates | Must release in `dispose()` |
|---|---|
| `addEventListener` | `removeEventListener` with same reference + options |
| `setTimeout` / `setInterval` | `clearTimeout` / `clearInterval` |
| `requestAnimationFrame` | `cancelAnimationFrame` |
| `new MutationObserver` / Intersection / Resize | `.disconnect()` |
| `THREE.BufferGeometry` | `.dispose()` |
| `THREE.Material` | `.dispose()` + all texture slots |
| `THREE.Texture` | `.dispose()` — or register via `SceneObject._ownedTextures` |
| `THREE.Light` | `.parent?.remove(light)` + `light.dispose?.()` + target removal |
| `Element.animate()` | `.cancel()` |
| Debounce / scheduler | `.offCancel()` |
| Theatre subscription | Call returned unsubscribe |
| Scene pub/sub subscription | Call returned unsubscribe |

Use the helpers:
- `utils/disposeObject3D.ts` — traverses an Object3D, disposes geometries + materials (with all 21 texture slots + shader uniform textures).
- `utils/disposeObject3D.ts#removeAndDispose(node)` — detach from parent and dispose.

### Side effects
- Constructors: wiring only. No DOM queries, no RAF, no fetches, no listener registration. Do it in `init()`/`mount()`.
- Module top-level: no side effects. No `window.addEventListener` at import time. No singletons created at import time.
- Static fields: no mutable state. If you need tracking (e.g., `ContactWizard._instances`), it must be reset by a static `dispose()`.

## A5. THREE.js GPU/CPU optimization playbook

### Render-loop hot path rules (hard bans)

1. **No `new Vector2/Vector3/Matrix4/Quaternion/Euler` inside `runUpdate`, `render`, or any per-frame callback.**
   - Use module-scope or instance `_scratch` fields. Mutate with `.copy()`, `.set()`, `.applyMatrix4()`.
2. **No object literals inside per-frame paths.**
   - Cache resolved options in an instance scratch object. Recompute only when inputs change (in `setOptions`, not in `runUpdate`).
3. **No `scene.getObjectByName()` per frame.** Use `context.getObject(id)` (O(1) Map lookup) or subscribe via `Scene.onObjectRegistered`.
4. **No `new Set()` / `Object.keys()` / `Array.from()` inside hot path.** Pre-compute key arrays when source changes.
5. **No `.getSnapshot()` called more than once per frame.** Cache locally in the function.
6. **No `uniform.tX.value = texture` per frame.** Textures set once at material creation; only scalars/vectors update per frame.

### World matrix freshness

- Before reading `object.matrixWorld` or `object.getWorldPosition()`, call `object.updateWorldMatrix(true, false)` if the render hasn't run yet this frame.
- Known call sites that already do this: `Engine._resolveFollowAnchor`, `CameraTargetRuntime.resolveFollowAnchor`, `CloudPlane._applyRocketUniforms`.

### GPU memory

- Every cached model must be cloned with independent materials. `ModelLoader.loadGLTF` handles this via `_cloneMaterialsInPlace` — don't bypass.
- Shader swaps on cached meshes must guard against re-application. Use `userData.__<name>Applied` tag (see `Ground._applyGroundShader`).
- On page teardown: `Engine.dispose()` → `Scene.dispose()` → every `SceneObject.dispose()` → `disposeObject3D(timelineRoot)`.
- Secondary renderers (like `WorksSceneManager`): must call `renderer.dispose()` AND `renderer.forceContextLoss()`.

### Materials / shaders

- Clone materials before mutation to avoid cache pollution: `material.clone()`.
- `onBeforeCompile` closures must not retain frame-local state. Store uniform refs in `userData.shader` for later mutation.
- `needsUpdate = true` is set exactly once (after `onBeforeCompile` assignment). Never in the render loop.

### Post-processing

- `EffectComposer.setSize(w, h)` receives CSS pixels (composer applies pixel ratio internally).
- `UnrealBloomPass.resolution.set(w, h)` receives CSS pixels (matches composer).
- Do not call `renderer.setSize()` inside the render loop. Use a resize listener → `ResponsiveRuntime` dispatch.

### Profiling

- Chrome DevTools Performance → look for frames > 16.67ms and GC sawteeth.
- `chrome://tracing` / WebGL Inspector for draw-call counts.
- Self-check: 60fps with GC events < 2/sec. Allocation profiler should show ~0 new Vector2/Vector3/Object per frame.

## A6. Responsive architecture

The project centralizes all responsive state through `ResponsiveRuntime` (pub/sub). Build new responsive features on top of it; do not add ad-hoc `window.matchMedia` listeners.

### Contract

```ts
const runtime = ResponsiveRuntime.getDefault();
const snapshot = runtime.getSnapshot();
// snapshot.breakpoint: "sm" | "md" | "lg" | "xl"
// snapshot.viewportWidth / viewportHeight
// snapshot.render.clampedPixelRatio
// snapshot.device.isMobile
// snapshot.reducedMotion
// snapshot.performance tier

const unsubscribe = runtime.subscribe((next) => {
  // react to breakpoint / viewport / reduced motion changes
});
// In dispose(): unsubscribe();
```

### Extension rules

- **New responsive value:** derive from `snapshot` inside the consumer. Don't add fields to `ResponsiveSnapshot` unless multiple consumers need it.
- **Config with breakpoint variance:** use `utils/ResponsiveValue.ts` (`{ sm, md, lg, xl, default }`) — declare in `config/`, resolve at call site.
- **Reduced motion:** check `snapshot.reducedMotion` and provide a degraded path (no infinite loops, no parallax). Required for accessibility.
- **Pixel ratio / performance tier:** read `snapshot.render.clampedPixelRatio` and `snapshot.performance` — used by `Engine` and `PostProcessor` automatically. Pass the snapshot through, don't re-derive.
- **Orientation / mobile only:** prefer `snapshot.device.isMobile` over UA sniffing.
- **Three.js resizing:** single path. Resize listener → `ResponsiveRuntime.updateFromWindow()` → subscribers (`Engine.applyResponsiveSnapshot`, `PostProcessor.resize`, `WorksSceneManager`). Do not bind `window.resize` in new code.

### CSS integration

- `ResponsiveRuntime._applyCssVariables(snapshot)` publishes CSS custom properties. Read them in SCSS via `var(--vw, 1vw)` etc., not through JS-computed inline styles.

### Touch vs hover

- Hover UX (`mouseenter` / `mouseleave`) stays on `MouseEvent` semantics — it's desktop-only by design.
- Drag / press / click target → `PointerEvent` (`pointerdown` / `pointerup` / `pointermove`) with `pointerId` tracking. See `CustomCursor` and `WorksPageRuntime` patterns.

### Anti-patterns (do not ship)

- Inline `@media` in TypeScript conditions (`if (window.innerWidth < 768)`). Use the snapshot.
- `matchMedia` listener per component. Use `ResponsiveRuntime.subscribe`.
- Hardcoded breakpoint numbers in TS. Source them from `config/` or from `snapshot.breakpoint`.
- Fighting against `prefers-reduced-motion` (autoplay, infinite animations). Respect it.

## Permission setup — `allowDangerouslySkipPermissions`

To prevent Claude Code from asking for permission on every action, enable via VS Code:

1. Open **File → Preferences → Settings** (or `Ctrl+,`)
2. Search for `claudeCode.allowDangerouslySkipPermissions`
3. Check the box — this adds "Bypass permissions" to the mode cycle

> **Warning:** This flag auto-approves all tool use: file writes, Bash execution, etc.
> Use only in trusted projects. Default permission mode is recommended for unfamiliar codebases.

## Why npm build commands are forbidden

`npm run build`, `npm run watch`, and `npm install` are **forbidden during normal development**.

- **Reason:** Vite dev server at `http://localhost:8888` auto-rebuilds the bundle on every file save
- Running these wastes context and time with no benefit
- **Exception:** `npm install <package>` — only when explicitly adding a new dependency
- This rule is enforced in three places: CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md, and `.claude/rules/frontend.md`

## How the tsc PostToolUse hook works

When a `.ts` file is modified via the Edit or Write tool, the PostToolUse hook fires automatically:

```bash
# Command executed by the hook
chop node_modules/.bin/tsc --noEmit
```

- Hook config: `.claude/settings.json` → `PostToolUse` → matcher: `Edit|Write`
- If tsc errors are found, the hook returns `exit(1)`, immediately notifying Claude
- **How to verify:** Edit any `.ts` file with the Edit tool → check hook output for tsc results

## 최적화 전략 (best practice 기준)

원칙: **각 룰은 정확히 한 곳에 산다.**

```
CLAUDE.md         → Claude 전용 deltas만 (Claude만 보는 메타)
AGENTS.md         → 크로스 커팅 / 아키텍처 / 보안 (모든 AI 공통)
.claude/rules/*   → 파일타입별 구체 룰 (해당 확장자 편집 시만 로드)
.claude/BEST_PRACTICES.md Part A → 코드 작성 결정트리 (참고서)
.claude/BEST_PRACTICES.md Part B → 하네스 메타 (사실상 1회성, 분리 검토)
```

## 제안 작업 (3 단계로 분리, 각각 승인 받고 진행)

**Step 2 — 중복 제거 (CLAUDE.md/AGENTS.md/rules 재배치)**

- `.claude/rules/scss.md`에 fluid/var-fallback 룰 보강

**Step 3 — BEST_PRACTICES.md 분리 검토 (선택)**
- Part B (하네스 체크리스트)는 1회 셋업 문서 성격 → 별도 `.claude/SETUP_CHECKLIST.md`로 분리하면 Part A만 남아 코드 작성 시 가독성 향상
